title: Quadratic Equation Solver
h1: Quadratic Equation Solver — ax² + bx + c
description: Solve ax² + bx + c = 0 for real roots, the discriminant and the vertex. Coefficients stay in the browser and are not uploaded.
intro: Enter a, b and c to see the discriminant, real roots when they exist, and the vertex of the parabola.
blurb: Solve a quadratic equation and show the discriminant, roots and vertex.
howItWorks: Enter the coefficients of ax² + bx + c = 0. a must not be zero.
Press Solve. The discriminant is b² − 4ac.
Copy the real roots, or the note that the roots are complex when the discriminant is negative.
examples: 1, 0, 1 has a negative discriminant, so no real roots.

faq.a: The equation is linear, not quadratic. The tool asks you to enter a non-zero a instead of silently switching formulas.
No. A negative discriminant is reported as no real roots. Only real roots are printed.
